name: Native Dependency Audit
description: Audit native dependencies for known vulnerabilities, outdated versions, and license compliance.
purpose: Proactively audit all native dependencies (compiled binaries, system libraries, platform-specific packages) to catch vulnerabilities, outdated versions, and license violations before they reach production.
acceptanceCriteria: Native dependency audit runs as a scheduled CI job (daily minimum).
Vulnerability scan covers all native binaries from the third-party binary inventory.
Outdated version detection flags any native dependency more than N minor versions behind latest.
License compliance check verifies all native dependencies have OSI-approved or project-accepted licenses.
Audit results are published as a structured report (JSON) with severity scoring.
Failed audit (critical vulnerability, license violation) blocks the release pipeline.
Audit history is retained for trend analysis and compliance reporting.
